title: dose.unit_mg input
description: The units to answer, in order (CR-D5: a whole list in one call): each a package record and its lot's TPE.

record.description: The state's package record; only weightPerUnit (g) and analyteWeight (the state's psilocybin, mg/g; 0 or null = none) are read. Any JSON value has an answer: one that isn't a number or null makes the unit's mg unknown (DOSE-9).

tpe.description: The lot's TPE (mg/g, coa.tpe), null or absent when not known.
